Fit XGBoost model for match outcome prediction

Source: R/models_xgboost.R
fit_xgboost.Rd

Trains an XGBoost classifier for predicting match outcomes (H/D/A) or goals. Supports multi-class classification and regression.

Usage

fit_xgboost(
  matches,
  features = NULL,
  target = "ftr",
  params = NULL,
  nrounds = 100L,
  early_stopping = 10L,
  verbose = 0L
)

Arguments

matches

A tibble with match data including features and outcome.

features

Character vector of feature column names. If NULL, uses default feature set.

target

Character. Target column: "ftr" for outcome (H/D/A), "fthg" for home goals, "ftag" for away goals.

params

List of XGBoost parameters. Defaults provided for classification or regression based on target.

nrounds

Integer. Number of boosting rounds (default 100).

early_stopping

Integer. Rounds without improvement to stop (default 10). Set to NULL to disable.

verbose

Integer. Verbosity level (0 = silent, default).

Value

A list with model (xgb.Booster), feature_names, target, params, and importance.
